title_plain: Who decides which new buildings are left out of on-street permit parking
title_official: Amendment to Municipal Code Chapter 27 (Council Procedures) and Municipal Code Chapter 925 (Permit Parking): Streamlining Permit Parking Exclusions for New Developments
drafted_by: Claude (AI), 13 Nov 2026, from the item page snapshot

documents.title: Public notice, City Clerk, 4 June 2026 (one-sentence excerpt)

methods: Written comments and speaking to the committee, both now closed

claims.text: This changes who decides when people at certain addresses cannot get on-street permit parking. Community Councils no longer make those changes for addresses in the area the City calls the Excluded Area, or for addresses tied to rezoning applications.

sources.quote: the authority delegated to Community Council does not include amendments to City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 925, Permit Parking, that exclude from eligibility residents of, visitors to, or tradepersons at addresses located within the Excluded Area

claims.text: The excluded addresses are gathered into one new list, called a schedule, in the permit parking chapter of the Municipal Code.

sources.quote: consolidate the excluded addresses into a new Schedule to the Chapter

claims.text: The Planning and Housing Committee considered it on 11 June 2026 and adopted it with no changes.

sources.quote: This item was considered by the Planning and Housing Committee on June 11, 2026 and adopted without amendment.

claims.text: City Council adopted it on 24 and 25 June 2026 with no changes.

sources.quote: City Council adopted this item on June 24 and 25, 2026 without amendments.

claims.text: The public notice asked people to contact the committee by 12 noon on Wednesday 10 June 2026 to comment or to speak.
